factors.label: Supplier-to-contract linkage
factors.description: Whether and how many suppliers are linked to real Mexican public contracts from official procurement sources.

evidence.description: Requirement r1 sets the linkage target from Mexican official procurement sources.

source.quote: Link at least 50 suppliers to real public contracts from Mexican official procurement sources (primary).

factors.label: Core profile completeness
factors.description: Degree to which each linked supplier has a complete profile across identity, address, founding date, tax-list status, and sanction status.

evidence.description: Job j2 defines the per-supplier core profile fields.

source.quote: Build a complete core profile per supplier (identity, address, founding date, tax-list status, sanction status) with evidence for every value.

factors.label: Evidence citation coverage
factors.description: Whether every recorded value carries cited evidence and how many distinct source classes are used.

evidence.description: Requirement r3 mandates evidence for every value and at least four source classes.

source.quote: Every recorded value must cite evidence; no unsourced values. Use at least 4 distinct source classes.

factors.label: Source authority tiering
factors.description: Which sources are treated as primary Mexican authority versus secondary US cross-checks.

evidence.description: Requirement r4 fixes the primary/secondary authority split.

source.quote: Use US sanctions and registry lists only as secondary cross-checks; Mexican official sources are primary authority.

factors.label: Budget and scope fit
factors.description: How the scope of suppliers and queries is sized to fit the run budget given unknown elapsed run time.

factors.label: Audience and investigative purpose
factors.description: Whether the output serves journalistic investigation of public-money recipients or civic transparency auditing of legitimacy, tax, and sanction status.

evidence.description: Persona p1 frames the journalistic angle.

source.quote: Investigative journalist examining who receives public money in Mexico via government contracts and whether they are legitimate companies.

evidence.description: Persona p2 frames the auditing angle.

source.quote: Civic transparency researcher auditing supplier legitimacy, tax-list status, and sanction status.
